book.name: Lebelesen
book.title: Lebelesen Gode Dofakamin Nakae mubiang amo wengo Yone baabasebe.

content: Omito abisake sbale abilim ut danea tlea ne atemio ayungo ge dabakanoa eka kwese e gabam oub dim uto gebane biotabe. E kibio bomat genoa makob afok tubunabo inanoa eka e skila afuna kumunao makob atolo blit blita binabo inaminobe.
E buk gwabo bamtabanobua wafunea e skile kweita sine aaye sole dang wat tamanea eka afan sin ele dabalim ele tama nanea atemna bia
e weng sumo makob til laioni weng ngambinabib inanea ngananabea eka am sumo 7 ngambianoa
wengo obiam namsoa ne dolanamabi otane weng mako abilim ut danoa baanoa Yeye, kobo weng olo mo dolanemebe, besa funale ge baatnesoa wentena bia
eka abisake sino e skilono make aaye sole dang dim wat tamanea eka milim sine dabalim ele tama nabia atemie kweile kweita sine tofanea

Gode kintaline abil esa inamin namino abilimo bu osa eka dabal esa inamin namino dabalimo bu osa eka aaye sol esa inamin namino e dang dimo bu osa klanebu ele niniino taisanea baanea Am olo tlang gamo hebmamsab tlamabobo gesea atemibe.
Sinanggwano Gode kukub ayoko wengo e weng omkeimalin naka ita omkaye binebu otane am olo dimo abisake sebene e bigule obanang game dimo kukub olo bain inanoa tam tlamabobe.

Eka sino weng mako abilim ut danoa baatnenoa wentio imin baatnenoa Kobo moneba abisake aaye sol esa eka dabal esa o dim wat mabie e kweilon dimo buk gwabo bamtabanobuo e wafu omtoubiebo, omone ge baatneno kesoa
ne monia abisak esu unania baabania Kobo buk gwab olo omnene gesia e baatnenea Omoneba dowonale o dowonang gaebo mema omatdanemebo kin gam dikin otane dukgeneba unamota kokobo ge baatnesea
omeisania kin gam inamin dowei otane anang tem daako koke tamatnesea

weng mako baatnenoa Kobo Gode weng olo imin omkeimaneba inamin namin kukubo naka homon unang homoni bib mak bib mak ye blib isa eka weng afet isa eka komok sum isa i dimo tam tlamabo wengo baabenale genoa wentibe.
